hashRule: sha256 over canonical JSON of this file, exposed by threeTierCriteriaHash() next to robustnessCriteriaHash(); every later ontology manifest and report pins it, and readiness refuses drift

trainOrder.reason: The memory train is strictly sequential. This file is frozen before any ontology arm runs on a development partition; held-out reads belong to plan 210 Task 9.

workOutcomeCriterion.decision: O8 thresholds are fixed here and plan 209 computes the row
workOutcomeCriterion.reason: Plan 209's work-outcome suite is built after this plan. It writes these thresholds unchanged into work-outcome-criteria.json as the row `ontology-work`; this file pins that row by name.

triggerPolicy.decision: compare read-time consolidation only against the three default policies in the Task 5 screen
triggerPolicy.reason: The cheaper policy may become the default when the two are non-inferior to each other; the losing policy is recorded for plan 210.

releaseGating.decision: the ontology tier ships opt-in either way; only its default and its published claims depend on the verdict
releaseGating.reason: 0.13.0 does not wait for a passing verdict.

partitions.heldOutOwner: plan 210 Task 9 (gate 3); heldout-b is the one shared remediation round, never a second

curator.rule: The default curator model is the answer agent's own model: ontologyModel is left unset. Gate O-1 names the concrete model per route; a different curator model is a new arm, not a revision of this file.

arms.pairing: each +O arm is compared paired, per question, against its own base arm on the same answer model and judge panel

triggerPolicies.default: the three default policies of plan 207

abilities.other: every ability of the suites above that is not listed as consolidation-sensitive
abilities.rule: Fixed from plan 202's partitions before any ontology arm runs. Per-ability benefit is not a criterion: held-out strata hold 2-6 items, so the named abilities are pooled.

statistics.method: paired cluster analysis of scripts/memory-bench/stats.mjs (clustered by source conversation or haystack), lower bound of the paired difference

O1.name: benefit
O1.metric: pooled paired accuracy difference (P+O minus P) over the consolidation-sensitive abilities

O3.name: claim support
O3.panel: plan 199 createJudgePanel, distinct-model judges, position-swapped citation order

O8.name: work outcomes
O8.W5: concept claims are covered through O3's audit
O8.computedBy: plan 209 Task 6 on development partitions, plan 210 Task 9 on held-out partitions

outcomeClasses.beneficial: O2 through O7 pass, and O1 or O8 passes
outcomeClasses.safe-neutral: O2 through O7 pass, O1 and O8 fail

noTextRule: Reports carry ids, labels, counts, rates and scores; never question, gold, note, claim or corpus text.
